concept: 车正面阻击——王紧跟支援
question_cn: 车王对兵王纵向攻击的方式是
question_en: The rook is already blocking the pawn's path head-on — what should the own king do?

options.text_cn: 王向远离兵的方向绕行，避开对方王
options.text_en: King detours away from the pawn to avoid the enemy king

options.text_cn: 车王时刻注意对升变格的控制， 车纵向阻击或后向攻击
options.text_en: King follows closely toward the pawn, forming a 「rook blocks, king supports」 formation

options.text_cn: 车离开阻击位，改为侧面将军骚扰
options.text_en: Rook leaves the blocking square and switches to side checks to harass

options.text_cn: 车和王分头行动，各自为政
options.text_en: Rook and king act independently without coordination

explanation_cn: 车正面阻击时，对方王会强行逼近试图赶走我方车。己方王必须及时跟进，和车形成「车顶住前排、王在后方支援」的协作阵型。王介入后对方王无法靠近兵，我方终将吃掉兵取胜。
explanation_en: When the rook blocks head-on, the enemy king will try to drive it away. The own king must follow closely to back the rook up. With the king supporting, the enemy king cannot approach, and the pawn falls.
